select_keyframes_from_shots: select keyframes from a list of shots based on minimum distance between camera centers
create_perspective_camera_from_pano: create a perspective camera from a panorama camera with a specified output size
scale_camera_dimensions: scale a camera width and height down to fit within a maximum size
undistort_panorama_images: undistort a panorama image into four perspective views using PanoramaUndistorter and render_panorama
undistort_shot_images: undistort a shot image handling panorama, perspective, or fisheye projection types with undistort_shot
